content.title: Update release workflow and gitignore for docs overhaul
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

After library-developer removes TypeDoc and library-release writes new docs, update the project configuration:

1. Edit .github/workflows/release.yml: remove the TypeDoc generation step and GitHub Pages deployment step. These relied on TypeDoc which is now removed. Docusaurus deployment will be a separate future task.
2. Edit .gitignore: remove the docs-html/ entry (no longer relevant since we removed TypeDoc HTML output).

This is a CTO-owned task because these files are in CTO's access domain.
